[USER] User has never tried acupuncture before and asked for tips on what to expect during a session.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a list of tips on what to expect during an acupuncture session:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Acupuncturist will ask about medical history, symptoms, and concerns, and may examine the tongue and pulse.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. User will lie down on a comfortable table, and the acupuncturist will insert thin, sterile needles into specific points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. User may feel a slight sensation like a pinch or dull ache, but it should not be painful; discomfort should be reported.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. User will relax with the needles in for about 20 to 40 minutes, possibly feeling calmness and relaxation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. After the session, the acupuncturist will remove the needles and may offer herbal remedies or self-care advice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is crucial to communicate openly with the acupuncturist throughout the session.
